title: SA open data: preserved copies of South African local-government datasets
description:
A verifiable copy of four South African public datasets about local government, plus a municipal identifier crosswalk across all five sources, captured 9–10 November 2026. Published because two of the sources are not preserved anywhere else.

Contents

  • Municipal Money (National Treasury / OpenUp): 292 municipal financial profiles — grants, cash coverage, UIFW expenditure, repairs and maintenance, debtors collection, budgets and spending, plus audit opinions and mayoral contacts. Also 292 geographies and 21,538 long-format indicator rows.
  • AGSA audit outcomes (Auditor-General of South Africa): 257 auditees × 8 periods (2017-18 to 2024-25) = 2,056 audit opinions, from the MFMA 2024-25 site.
  • IEC council composition (Electoral Commission): seats by party and largest party for 213 councils after the 2016 and 2021 local elections.
  • Stats SA P9115: free basic services per municipality — indigent households identified and beneficiaries of water, electricity, sanitation and waste, with coverage ratios.

Added after v0.1.0, in this version: a municipal identifier crosswalk — 292 rows carrying Municipal Money, IEC, AGSA, Stats SA P9115 and open-admin-data keys on the same row (257 live entities: 8 metro, 205 local, 44 district; 35 disestablished pre-2016 entities kept because AGSA still carries their audit history), with the eight residual matches listed rather than guessed; and SOURCES.md, a ledger of 99 South African data sources recording publisher, access mechanism, whether it is held, and the date checked. This version also carries a correction: Municipal Money's is_disestablished flag marks boundary change rather than liveness and is set for two live Limpopo municipalities (LIM343 Thulamela, LIM344 Makhado), so the live count is 205 local + 44 district + 8 metro = 257, not the 211 municipalities the raw flag implies.

Why this copy exists. The Auditor-General's MFMA site is year-stamped (mfma-2025) and the Internet Archive holds exactly one capture of it — the landing page — with none of the API responses. The Electoral Commission's results site has no usable Internet Archive captures at all, and the /api/v1/ path used to obtain the council data returned HTTP 404 on reprobe five days later. Without this record the 2026 local-government picture would exist only on servers that are scheduled to change.

Included: the datasets, per-dataset READMEs, a provenance document recording publisher, endpoint, capture date, live-reprobe status and archive status for each source; a method document; a caveats document; and the unmodified fetchers and derivations.

Verification: MANIFEST.json carries a SHA-256 checksum, byte count, record count and source URL for every data file. The README includes a script that re-checks the tree.

Caveats, stated plainly: 292 Municipal Money profiles is not the same population as 257 AGSA auditees (37 profiles are disestablished pre-2016 entities); two municipalities are both named Emalahleni; a null indicator means not computed, never zero; capital_budget_spending is a signed variance where negative means underspent; and no analysis in this repository makes a causal claim. P9115 free-basic-service figures reflect submission behaviour rather than delivery and should not be used to rank parties.

The underlying statistics are produced by National Treasury, the Auditor-General, the IEC and Statistics South Africa from public money, and are not the author's to license — what is licensed here is the arrangement, the derived tables and the documentation.
